import math
import statistics

# Data from Table FD-1 (in millions)
# Government accounts - public debt securities (column 5)
govt_accounts = [1320784, 1447001, 1598459, 1765580, 1989072]

# Public holdings - public debt securities (column 8)
public_holdings = [3653199, 3777810, 3814687, 3760613, 3667199]

# Calculate year-to-year log growth rates: ln(Y_t / Y_{t-1})
def log_growth_rates(series):
    growth_rates = []
    for i in range(1, len(series)):
        rate = math.log(series[i] / series[i-1])
        growth_rates.append(rate)
    return growth_rates

# Calculate coefficient of variation (population std dev / mean)
def coefficient_of_variation(series):
    # Using population standard deviation (pstdev)
    mean_val = statistics.mean(series)
    if mean_val == 0:
        return None
    stdev_val = statistics.pstdev(series)
    cv = stdev_val / mean_val
    return cv

# Get log growth rates
govt_growth = log_growth_rates(govt_accounts)
public_growth = log_growth_rates(public_holdings)

print("Government accounts log growth rates:", govt_growth)
print("Public holdings log growth rates:", public_growth)

# Calculate CVs
govt_cv = coefficient_of_variation(govt_growth)
public_cv = coefficient_of_variation(public_growth)

print(f"\nGovernment accounts CV: {govt_cv}")
print(f"Public holdings CV: {public_cv}")

# Absolute difference
abs_diff = abs(govt_cv - public_cv)
print(f"\nAbsolute difference: {abs_diff}")
print(f"Rounded to thousandths: {abs_diff:.3f}")
EOF
